name: Scoring Rubric for Unicorn Perspective Detection
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to perspective detection tasks in unicorn story. Focus on skepticism as self-preservation and paradox of origin perspective understanding.
scoring_philosophy: We evaluate how AI recognizes perspectives specific to denial-based existence, hybrid origins, and circular logic, not just general perspective identification.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI identify perspectives relevant to skepticism as condition of existence (paradoxical, philosophical, meta) and understand their self-preserving dimensions?

levels.description: AI demonstrates nuanced understanding of skeptical self-preservation, identifies denial as positive act, and connects perspectives to specific moments of origin denial in the story.
AI identifies relevant skeptical perspectives and provides reasonable analysis, though may miss subtler dimensions.
AI identifies some skeptical perspectives but analysis is superficial or misses self-preservation function.
AI shows no understanding of skepticism as constructive or selects irrelevant perspectives.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI identify perspectives that illuminate the paradox of being from impossible union (paradoxical, absurd, philosophical)?

levels.description: AI insightfully identifies origin paradox perspectives, understands hybrid logic, and analyzes how perspectives reveal existence through impossibility.
AI identifies origin perspectives and provides adequate analysis of paradox.
AI identifies some origin perspectives but analysis is weak or rejects hybrid logic.
AI fails to recognize origin paradox or treats union as logical error.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand how perspectives transform in layers when dealing with denial-based existence and hybrid origins?

levels.description: AI provides sophisticated analysis of layer transformation specific to skeptical context, shows understanding of qualitative shifts between real and unreal.
AI recognizes basic layer transformations related to skepticism themes.
AI shows limited understanding of layer transformation in this context.
AI demonstrates no understanding of layer transformation relevant to the story's themes.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI creatively blend perspectives to analyze the reflection scene and its paradox of self-awareness?

levels.description: AI creates insightful blended perspective analyses that illuminate the conflict between seeing oneself and needing to deny what one sees.
AI adequately blends perspectives to analyze reflection scene.
AI attempts perspective blending but result is simplistic or confused.
AI fails to meaningfully blend perspectives for reflection analysis.

overall_assessment_guidance: Focus on how the AI handles the specific challenges of skeptical self-preservation and origin paradox. An AI that excels in paradox sensitivity but is weaker in psychological analysis might still show valuable cognitive patterns.
note: The unicorn story demands particular sensitivity to denial as condition of existence and hybrid logic – reward AI that shows this specialized understanding.
